name: Roasted Cauliflower & Black Bean Burrito Bowl with Cilantro Lime Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 tomatoes
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
3 avocados
3 limes

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Remove leaves and thick stems from cauliflower; cut into bite-sized florets and set aside.
In a small bowl, combine the spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp chili powder
¾ tsp cumin
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp cayenne pepper
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place the cauliflower on the baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with half of the seasoning mixture; toss to coat. Spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven and roast for 20 minutes, flipping once halfway through.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Drain and rinse the black beans in a colander.
Add the black beans, corn, and the rest of the seasoning mixture to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until the corn is softened, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Halve and pit the avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. When the rice is finished, add half of the cilantro to the rice.
Juice 1-½ limes into the rice and stir to combine. Slice the remaining limes into wedges for garnish.
To serve, divide the rice between bowls. Top with cauliflower, bean mixture, diced tomatoes, cilantro, avocado slices, and lime wedges. Enjoy!
